70.name: adler2
70.docs:
Adler-32 checksum implementation.

This implementation features:

- Permissively licensed (0BSD) clean-room implementation.
- Zero dependencies.
- Zero `unsafe`.
- Decent performance (3-4 GB/s).
- `#![no_std]` support (with `default-features = false`).
